description: This file defines a custom JSON converter class 'StreamImplConverter' for serializing and deserializing Orleans streaming stream objects, specifically 'StreamImpl<>' and 'IAsyncStream<>', using Newtonsoft.Json. It handles reading JSON to instantiate stream objects and writing stream object properties to JSON.

classes.name: StreamImplConverter
classes.description: A custom JSON converter for serializing and deserializing Orleans stream objects, handling 'StreamImpl<>' and 'IAsyncStream<>' types.

methods.name: StreamImplConverter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the converter with an IRuntimeClient instance.

methods.name: CanConvert
methods.description: Determines if the converter can handle the specified object type, specifically 'StreamImpl<>' or 'IAsyncStream<>'.

methods.name: ReadJson
methods.description: Reads JSON data to create and return an Orleans stream object based on the JSON properties.

methods.name: WriteJson
methods.description: Serializes an Orleans stream object into JSON format, including streamId, providerName, and isRewindable properties.
